definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tagħżel jew iddawwar is-suf jew il-qoton biex tagħmel il-ħajt

usage_examples.mt: Il-għażżiel kien mimli ħajt u ħarir wara ġimgħa sħiħa ta' xogħol.
usage_examples.en: The spinner was full of thread and silk after a whole week of work.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għażżiela kienu jaħdmu flimkien fid-dar tas-suf tar-raħal.
usage_examples.en: The spinners used to work together in the village wool house.

definitions.text_mt: Ċriev żgħir u grazzjuż, oriġinarjament mill-Afrika u l-Asja
Insetta li tagħmel ħoss qawwi u ritmiku matul is-sajf

definitions.text_en: female equivalent of għażżiel (“ spinner, one who spins ”)
definitions.text_mt: Mara li tagħżel jew iddawwar is-suf jew il-qoton biex tagħmel il-ħajt
Persuni li jagħżlu jew idawwru s-suf jew il-qoton biex jagħmlu l-ħajt

usage_examples.mt: Il-għażżiela ġriet malajr mal-pjanura wara li rat il-predatur.
usage_examples.en: The gazelle ran quickly across the plain after spotting the predator.

usage_examples.mt: Is-smigħ tal-għażżiela kien jinstema' mill-bogħod f'lejl sħun tas-sajf.
usage_examples.en: The sound of the cicada could be heard from afar on a hot summer night.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għażżiela kienet tiftaħar bil-ħila tagħha fit-tidwir tas-suf.
usage_examples.en: The spinner woman took pride in her skill at spinning wool.

definitions.text_mt: Li ma jħobbx jaħdem jew jagħmel sforz, li jevita l-impenn

usage_examples.mt: Ibnu huwa tant għażżien li jqatta' l-ġurnata kollha fuq is-sufan.
usage_examples.en: His son is so lazy that he spends the whole day on the sofa.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qattus għażżien tiegħi jorqod tmintax-il siegħa kuljum.
usage_examples.en: My lazy cat sleeps eighteen hours a day.

usage_examples.mt: Mhux għażżien, imma jippreferi jaħdmu bil-mod u bir-reqqa.
usage_examples.en: He is not lazy, but he prefers to work slowly and carefully.

definitions.text_mt: Telaq u ma baqax jidher, sparixxa

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xemx għebet wara l-baħar u l-lejl beda jinżel.
usage_examples.en: The sun disappeared behind the sea and the night began to fall.

usage_examples.mt: L-għasfur għeb fil-boskijiet u ma rajnieh qatt aktar.
usage_examples.en: The bird disappeared into the woods and we never saw it again.

definitions.text_en: superseded spelling of Ebrew: (of a person) Hebrew
definitions.text_mt: Ortografija skartata ta' 'Ebrew': (ta' persuna) Lhudi

usage_examples.mt: Ktieb Għebrew antik instab fil-librerija tal-università.
usage_examples.en: An ancient Hebrew book was found in the university library.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kitba Għebrea hija fost l-eqdem lingwi li għadhom jintużaw illum.
usage_examples.en: Hebrew writing is among the oldest languages still in use today.

definitions.text_en: Eden (the paradise of Adam and Eve)
definitions.text_mt: Il-ġnien tal-Ġenna fejn għexu Adam u Eva skont il-ġrajja Bibblika

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġnien tal-Għeden huwa deskritt bħala post ta' sbuħija perfetta.
usage_examples.en: The Garden of Eden is described as a place of perfect beauty.

usage_examples.mt: Skont it-tradizzjoni, Adam u Eva għexu fil-Għeden qabel il-waqgħa.
usage_examples.en: According to tradition, Adam and Eve lived in Eden before the fall.

definitions.text_mt: Mibgħeda jew ostilità bejn żewġ persuni jew aktar

usage_examples.mt: Il-għedwa bejn iż-żewġ familji damet aktar minn ġenerazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: The enmity between the two families lasted more than a generation.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-argument, kien hemm għedwa qawwija bejniethom.
usage_examples.en: After the argument, there was strong enmity between them.

definitions.text_mt: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' enerġija u bżonn ta' mistrieħ wara attività fiżika jew mentali

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-maratona, ħass għeja kbira f'ġismu kollu.
usage_examples.en: After the marathon, he felt great tiredness throughout his whole body.

usage_examples.mt: L-għeja bdiet tieħu qabża wara li ħadem ħmistax-il siegħa konsekuttivi.
usage_examples.en: Tiredness began to take over after he worked fifteen consecutive hours.

definitions.text_mt: Sar għajjien, tilef l-enerġija u l-qawwa wara sforz

usage_examples.mt: Għeja wara li ġarr il-kaxxi tqal sa tliet sulari.
usage_examples.en: He became tired after carrying the heavy boxes up three floors.

usage_examples.mt: L-istudent għeja waqt l-eżami twil ta' tliet sigħat.
usage_examples.en: The student became tired during the long three-hour exam.

definitions.text_en: verbal noun of għeb: act of disappearing
definitions.text_mt: L-azzjoni ta' meta xi ħadd jisparixxi jew jitlaq, il-ħruġ minn post fejn kien preżenti

usage_examples.mt: L-għejbien tal-ajruplan baqa' misteru għal ħafna snin.
usage_examples.en: The disappearance of the plane remained a mystery for many years.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-għejbien tiegħu, ħadd ma sema' xħin ġralu.
usage_examples.en: After his disappearance, nobody heard what happened to him.

definitions.text_mt: Għamel lil xi ħadd għajjien ħafna, eżawrixxa bil-ħidma jew b'attività kontinwa

usage_examples.mt: Din il-ġirja twila għejjietni ħafna u għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
usage_examples.en: This long run exhausted me a lot and I need to rest.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħidma ta' kuljum fuq ir-razzett għejjiet lill-bdiewa kollha.
usage_examples.en: The daily work on the farm exhausted all the farmers.

definitions.text_mt: Għonnella żgħira, il-libsa tradizzjonali Maltija żgħira li kienu jilbsu n-nisa

usage_examples.mt: Ommi libset għejnilla għall-festa tar-raħal is-Sibt li għadda.
usage_examples.en: My mother wore a small għonnella for the village feast last Saturday.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għejnilla kienet miksija bil-bizzilla bajda u ħadra.
usage_examples.en: The small għonnella was trimmed with white and green lace.

definitions.text_mt: Mibegħda u rabja lejn xi ħadd minħabba s-suċċess jew il-ġid tiegħu

usage_examples.mt: Il-għejra qerdet il-ħbiberija tagħhom wara tant snin flimkien.
usage_examples.en: Jealousy destroyed their friendship after so many years together.

usage_examples.mt: Ma tistax tgħix ħajja kuntenta jekk int mimli bl-għejra.
usage_examples.en: You cannot live a happy life if you are full of envy.

definitions.text_mt: Il-mod kif wieħed jaqla' l-għajxien u jsostni lilu nnifsu u lill-familja
Il-flus jew ir-riżorsi meħtieġa għall-għajxien ta' kuljum ta' persuna
Il-ħila li wieħed jibqa' ħaj minkejja perikli jew diffikultajiet
L-eżistenza u l-attivitajiet ta' kuljum ta' persuna

usage_examples.mt: Jaħtiegħu jaħdmu żewġ impjiegi biex jaqilgħu l-għejxien għall-familja.
usage_examples.en: They need to work two jobs to earn a living for the family.

usage_examples.mt: L-għejxien fil-gżira kien iebes qabel ma wasal it-turiżmu.
usage_examples.en: Livelihood on the island was hard before tourism arrived.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bdiewa jiddependu fuq ix-xita għall-għejxien tagħhom.
usage_examples.en: Farmers depend on rain for their survival.

definitions.text_mt: Sar jaħraq biżżejjed biex likwidu jibda jagħli u jsir fwar
Tgħalla f'likwidu sħun, ġie msajjar bl-għali
Kellu togħma morra u mhux ħelwa
Ħass mrar jew rabja f'qalbu minħabba esperjenza ħażina
Tela' fil-prezz, sar aktar għali
Sar għali, żdied fil-valur jew fil-prezz

usage_examples.mt: L-ilma għela u jista' jintuża biex issajjar il-makaruni.
usage_examples.en: The water boiled and can be used to cook the pasta.

usage_examples.mt: Il-prezz taż-żejt għela b'mod drammatiku din is-sena.
usage_examples.en: The price of oil rose dramatically this year.

usage_examples.mt: Qalbu għelitlu meta sema' bil-mewt ta' ħuh.
usage_examples.en: His heart felt bitter when he heard of his brother's death.

definitions.text_en: to overcome, to defeat, to win out over
definitions.text_mt: Rebaħ fuq għadu jew diffikultà, għelibhom u kiseb is-supremazija

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġellieda Maltin għelbu lill-għadu minkejja n-numri iżgħar tagħhom.
usage_examples.en: The Maltese warriors overcame the enemy despite their smaller numbers.

usage_examples.mt: Għeleb il-biża' tiegħu u tkellem quddiem il-folla kbira.
usage_examples.en: He overcame his fear and spoke in front of the large crowd.

definitions.text_en: to make a mistake, to err
definitions.text_mt: Ħarab mill-verità jew minn dak li kien mistenni, żbalja

usage_examples.mt: Jekk tgħodd mingħajr attenzjoni, tista' tgħeleb faċilment.
usage_examples.en: If you count without attention, you can make a mistake easily.

usage_examples.mt: L-istudent għelet fit-tweġiba għax ma qarax il-mistoqsija sew.
usage_examples.en: The student erred in the answer because he did not read the question carefully.

definitions.text_mt: Ir-rebħa fuq l-għadu jew fuq diffikultà, it-telfa ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: L-għelib tal-avversarju kien importanti għat-tim kollu.
usage_examples.en: The defeat of the opponent was important for the whole team.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-għelib tal-marda, qatt ma ħa s-saħħa għal mogħtija.
usage_examples.en: After overcoming the illness, he never took his health for granted.

definitions.text_mt: Sinjali jew marki li jidentifikaw jew jindikaw xi ħaġa
Qaddej, persuna li sservi lil ħaddieħor fid-dar jew f'istabbiliment
Persuna mjielda u mibjugħa taħt is-setgħa assoluta ta' ħaddieħor

usage_examples.mt: L-għeliem kienu jaqdu lil sidhom b'lealtà u dedikazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: The servants used to serve their master with loyalty and dedication.

usage_examples.mt: Il-għeliem kienu mibjugħa u mixtrija bħal merkanzija fi żmien il-kummerċ tal-iskjavi.
usage_examples.en: Slaves were bought and sold like goods during the slave trade era.

definitions.text_mt: Sustanza li twaħħal, ta' nisġa li tixbah l-għalf jew ir-reżina

usage_examples.mt: L-għelk li ħareġ mis-siġra kien jintuża biex isewwi l-istrumenti.
usage_examples.en: The gluey substance that came out of the tree was used to repair tools.

usage_examples.mt: L-għelk jista' jitqiegħed fuq il-ġilda bħala mediċina tradizzjonali.
usage_examples.en: The gluey substance can be applied to the skin as a traditional medicine.

definitions.text_mt: Xorti ħażina jew tbatija li tiġi lil xi ħadd
Marda jew kundizzjoni ħażina li taffettwa s-saħħa tal-ġisem

usage_examples.mt: Kienet għella li ma kienx jistħoqqilha, wara ħajja tant onesta.
usage_examples.en: It was a misfortune she did not deserve, after such an honest life.

usage_examples.mt: L-għella malajr infirxet mal-familja kollha u kellhom isejħu lit-tabib.
usage_examples.en: The illness quickly spread throughout the whole family and they had to call the doctor.

definitions.text_mt: Sinjal jew marka li turi xi ħaġa, indikazzjoni
Tikketta jew biċċa informazzjoni mwaħħla ma' oġġett għall-identifikazzjoni
Tagħrif u għerf li wieħed jakkumula permezz tal-istudju jew l-esperjenza

usage_examples.mt: Poġġa għelm fuq il-kaxxa biex tkun taf x'hemm ġewwa.
usage_examples.en: Put a label on the box so you know what is inside.

usage_examples.mt: L-għelm tat-triq kien moħbi wara s-siġar u ma stajniex narawh.
usage_examples.en: The road sign was hidden behind the trees and we could not see it.

usage_examples.mt: Dan il-ktieb fih ammont kbir ta' għelm dwar l-istorja ta' Malta.
usage_examples.en: This book contains a great amount of knowledge about the history of Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Żball li wieħed jagħmel meta ma jsegwix ir-regoli jew il-verità

usage_examples.mt: Kull għelt li tagħmel fit-tagħlim hija opportunità biex titgħallem.
usage_examples.en: Every mistake you make in learning is an opportunity to learn.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kont kellu għelt u l-ħanut ħallas lura l-flus żejda.
usage_examples.en: The bill had an error and the shop refunded the extra money.

usage_examples.mt: Jekk għamilt għelt, aghtarfu u pprova tikkoreġih.
usage_examples.en: If you made a mistake, admit it and try to correct it.

definitions.text_en: verbal noun of għalaq: closing, closure
definitions.text_mt: L-għalaq ta' xi ħaġa, l-azzjoni ta' meta xi ħaġa tingħalaq
It-tmiem ta' perjodu, attività jew avveniment

usage_examples.mt: L-għeluq tal-ħanut isir fid-disgħa ta' filgħaxija kull ġurnata.
usage_examples.en: The closing of the shop happens at nine in the evening every day.

usage_examples.mt: Fl-għeluq tal-laqgħa, il-president irringrazzja lil kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: At the end of the meeting, the president thanked everyone.

definitions.text_mt: Il-jum li fih twieled xi ħadd, iċ-ċelebrazzjoni annwali tat-twelid ta' persuna

usage_examples.mt: Il-għeluq snin tiegħi huwa fil-ħmistax ta' Ġunju.
usage_examples.en: My birthday is on the fifteenth of June.

usage_examples.mt: Għamilna festa kbira għall-għeluq snin in-nanna tagħna.
usage_examples.en: We had a big party for our grandmother's birthday.

usage_examples.mt: X'rigal se tixtri lil ħabibek għal għeluq sninu?
usage_examples.en: What gift will you buy your friend for his birthday?
